name: no-tasks
description: The source search matches no tasks -- the normal outcome of a scheduled sync that has already mirrored everything, and of a search filter that was typed wrong, which look identical from here. GET /api/v1.0/org/tasks is a bare array with no envelope and no pagination, so zero tasks is `[]`. The run must stop after the one listing request: nothing to download, nothing to import, and in particular nothing to HIDE, because hiding is keyed off a successful sync and a run that hid tasks it never transferred would destroy the operator's only view of what is still outstanding.
